ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA Open-ended Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: Read the figure <image1>. In the left figure, the shaded part represents the normal water-level contour line of this reservoir (elevation 101.6m), and the dashed line (elevation 102.2m) represents the water-area contour line after a certain continuous rainfall. What characteristic of the terrain is indicated by the places where the solid line and the dashed line overlap in the figure?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the left figure is a dendritic reservoir outline; the shaded area represents the reservoir range under the normal water level, and the peripheral dashed line represents the water-area outline formed after the water level rose following continuous rainfall; in the figure, the solid line of the shaded boundary and the dashed line almost overlap along some shore sections. The right figure is a schematic diagram of the precipitation impact around the reservoir; the judgment in this question is mainly based on the left figure. Then reason: the stem states that the solid line corresponds to an elevation of 101.6 m, the dashed line corresponds to an elevation of 102.2 m, and the elevation difference between the two is 0.6 m. If, after the water level rises by 0.6 m, the water-area outline has almost no outward expansion on the plane, it indicates that there is an obvious elevation difference within a very short horizontal distance at this place, that is, the slope is large. Therefore, the places where the solid line and the dashed line overlap indicate that the terrain there is steep.

method.method_draft: 先看左图：阴影水库边界代表正常水位的实线轮廓，外侧虚线代表降雨后水位升高后的水区轮廓；在某些岸段实线与虚线几乎重合。再读题干可知两条轮廓分别对应海拔101.6m和102.2m，相差0.6m。把这两条水边线理解为同一地形表面上两个不同高程的等高线：高程升高了0.6m但平面位置几乎没有外移，说明水平距离很小而高差存在，因此坡度大，判定该处地形陡峭。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：左图为树枝状水库轮廓，阴影区域表示正常水位下的水库范围，外围虚线表示持续降雨后水位升高形成的水区轮廓；图中有些岸段阴影边界的实线与虚线几乎重合。右图是水库周围降水影响示意，本题判断主要依据左图。
再推理：题干说明实线对应海拔101.6 m，虚线对应海拔102.2 m，二者高差为0.6 m。若水位升高0.6 m后，水区轮廓在平面上几乎没有向外扩展，说明该处在很短的水平距离内就有明显高差，即坡度大。因此实线和虚线重叠处指示该处地形陡峭。

method.method_draft: 先观察左图整体：多数水库边缘在降雨后虚线向外扩展，表示水面淹没范围变大；但题问的实线和虚线重叠处没有明显新增淹没带。结合题干，降雨后水位从101.6m升至102.2m，若岸边平缓，水位小幅上升会使水面向外铺展较宽；现在水位升高而边界不外扩，说明岸坡近乎陡岸，水只能向上升而难以向外扩展。因此该处地形陡峭。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左图显示水库轮廓呈树枝状，阴影部分表示正常水位时的水域轮廓，外围虚线表示持续降雨后水位升高形成的水区轮廓。多数水库边缘处，虚线相对实线向外扩展，说明降雨后淹没范围变大；但在部分实线和虚线重叠的地方，水位升高后边界几乎没有向外扩展。推理：题干给出正常水位为101.6m，降雨后水位为102.2m，水位上升了0.6m。若岸边地形平缓，水位小幅升高会使水面向外扩展较宽；而实线与虚线重叠说明水位升高但水平淹没范围变化很小，表示该处岸坡近乎陡立。因此该处地形特点是陡峭。

raw_record.original_question: 读图<image1>。左图中阴影部分表示该水库正常水位轮廓线（海拔101.6m），虚线（海拔102.2m）表示某次持续降雨后的水区轮廓线。图中实线和虚线重叠处指示该地形有什么特点？
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: the left figure is a dendritic reservoir outline; the shaded area represents the reservoir range under the normal water level, and the peripheral dashed line represents the water-area outline formed after the water level rose following continuous rainfall; in the figure, the solid line of the shaded boundary and the dashed line almost overlap along some shore sections. The right figure is a schematic diagram of the precipitation impact around the reservoir; the judgment in this question is mainly based on the left figure.
Then reason: the stem states that the solid line corresponds to an elevation of 101.6 m, the dashed line corresponds to an elevation of 102.2 m, and the elevation difference between the two is 0.6 m. If, after the water level rises by 0.6 m, the water-area outline has almost no outward expansion on the plane, it indicates that there is an obvious elevation difference within a very short horizontal distance at this place, that is, the slope is large. Therefore, the places where the solid line and the dashed line overlap indicate that the terrain there is steep.
